Name: FS-Putao's HD Closet
Author: putao1222
Description:
适配芭蕾体，有三款发型、两件上衣、一条短裤、七款连衣裙、四种眼睛贴图（两款眨眼）、五款发饰、八件配件和三双鞋子。

安装方式：确认mods文件夹有ContentPatcher和FashionSense，将下载好的压缩包解压到mods文件夹里。

鞋子走路时会有一帧坐下的贴图跳出来:/ ，我不知道怎么解决，如果有人知道怎么办请联系我，非常感谢:)

款式相似的部件很多，使用时可以把不想要的文件夹删掉。

图上的体型、袖子以及脸蛋仅为预览，获取方式↓

芭蕾体：
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45141

cherry的袖子：
https://m.blog.naver.com/tkfkdgi132/224297444310

为了不穿帮，推荐使用Kyuya的The emperor's clothes：

特别感谢小红书火把老师的高清模板！:D





Compatible with the Ballet Body. Includes 3 hairstyles, 2 tops, 1 pair of shorts, 7 dresses, 4 eye textures (2 with blinking), 5 hair accessories, 8 accessories, and 3 pairs of shoes.

Installation: Make sure you have ContentPatcher and FashionSense in your mods folder, then extract the downloaded archive into the mods folder.

There's a frame of a sitting pose that pops up when walking in shoes :/ I don't know how to fix these issues. If anyone knows a solution, please contact me. Thank you so much :)

Many of the parts are similar in style, so feel free to delete the folders you don't want to use.

The body type, sleeves, and face shown in the preview images are for reference only. Get them here ↓
